items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: And some people, I think, Bob Green, when he read it, said it's the best thing he ever read on, uh, New Orleans jazz

ctx.x: But, uh, it was, uh, the main idea was, uh, recorded it, but the main idea was to, uh, transcribe the talking and make a little booklet out of it with quite a few illustrations. It wasn't, uh, any, in any sense a drum method or anything, but he did, uh, talk about the, how the drums should fit into the New Orleans band and the right style to play. Mm-hmm. And he described his instruments and his own training and how he learned and, uh, a little bit about his life and, uh, a few little, colorful. He was a very…
